patch_description:
The current program introduces a CRZ diagonal entangler layer that performs poorly (convergence at 2160 steps vs 90 in prior program 2). CRZ gates with full parameter sharing appear to be a training bottleneck and cause worse worst_group_margin (0.28 vs 0.31).

Prior program 2 achieved better performance (0.59 score) using only Ising gates (XX/YY/ZZ) for two-qubit interactions, with 6 distinct 2-qubit couplings and no CRZ layer.

The fix:
1. Replace the 4 CRZ diagonal gates with 4 Ising gates (ZZ) with unique parameters
2. Remove the redundant mid-circuit RZ layer (which appears to be less effective than the pre/post RZ layers)
3. This reduces depth, improves convergence speed, and aligns with the proven prior architecture

This maintains parameter efficiency while using gates that empirically train faster and achieve better margins on hard samples.
